name: learning-skills
description: Learning science applied, with the LLM removing each method's historical labor barrier: spaced-retrieval-learning (the testing effect, spacing, and interleaving — retrieval prompts authored and scheduled for you), deliberate-practice (edge-of-ability drills with immediate feedback — the drill built and the environment played for you), and habit-design (implementation intentions, habit stacking, friction engineering). Each skill both runs the method and teaches why it works.
